curated.tagline: This site: a star-chart portfolio with live GitHub activity and a dossier per project
curated.description: The Next.js app behind luke-the-duke.com. The homepage is a solar map with a primary orbit of featured systems and a secondary orbit of the rest of the catalog; each project has a dossier page. A GitHub App ingests about 90 days of activity, rendered as condensed charts and grouped pull requests. The catalog in src/data is the single source of truth, nothing is auto-discovered.
highlights: Solar-map homepage: primary and secondary orbits driven from catalog data
About 90 days of GitHub App activity, shown as charts and grouped PRs with a 7d / 30d / 90d toggle
Dossier page per project, with private work shown through scrubbed labels only
Catalog SOP and tests keep the single source of truth consistent
curated.architecture: Catalog (src/data) → GitHub App ingest (ISR) → activity aggregation → orbit and dossier pages
